searchText: Hi all, I think the v12 version of the test suite is incorrect. At EthereumJS we now have failing tests on e.g. Chainstart/Frontier, for instance state test `HighGasPrice`. Any other clients experiencing this as well? On these tests, there are invalid txs provided, so the state root of the chain should not change. However, in the tests, it does change. (And only on chainstart/homestead/tangerine whistle, from spurious dragon all is fine) Ok, looks like something in the state runner has changed in state tests we calculated coinbase touch when it was run on besu as blockchain test. so no tx happens, block is empty, reward is 0, but coinbase get touched with reward 0, thus an empty account is created in the state Would that be this (fixed) bug? - https://github.com/hyperledger/besu/issues/5124 no. that one is about state.reward=-1 is disabling coinbase reward and touch. so just state hash calculation in all other cases. there is mining reward calculated. so coinbase is touched state.reward is mining reward amount, when it is 0, on <=EIP150 will create empty account for coinbase
